QuoteRequest.description:
Asks for the price of `quantity` × `sku`. Answered with [`PricingReply::Quote`] or
[`PricingReply::QuoteRejected`] to the sender.
QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest

state.description:
The state of an actor type that keeps no data: an empty struct, stored as `{}`. A state with a field does not
decode as `NoState`.
state.title: NoState
